newsitem.title: USA: ACI Telecentrics signs $5.5 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: ACI Telecentrics signs $5.5 mln contract.

text.p: ACI Telecentrics Inc said Wednesday it signed a contract valued at $5.5 million with CIDCO Inc to provide telemarketing services.
Under terms of the contract, ACI will telemarket CIDCO Caller ID telephone products and telephone company services for major service providers in the United States.
CIDCO, based in Morgan Hill, Calif., provides subscriber terminal equipment that supports intelligent network services offered by telephone operating companies.
ACI provides outbound telephone services to clients, primarily in the telecommunications, financial services and publishing industries.
